findings.description: The write-time filter only prevents new INFRA anchors; receipts already on disk are never pruned, so an existing '<llm-invoke>' sentinel anchor keeps failing attestation forever.

Filtering INFRA findings out of anchors removes the stale sentinel block but leaves no per-pass proof that a failed pass actually read the diff; coverage is computed per cycle, not per receipt, so a pass returning only an INFRA finding can still be attested when the other passes cover the floor.

No test exercised a pass whose only finding is the INFRA sentinel; the original test paired the infra finding with a normal code finding in the same pass, unlike a real timed-out pass which returns the infra finding alone.
